poses.name: 01_joy
poses.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE full-body emotional expression variation of the SAME mint-haired maid in the reference, for an existing game character cut-in.
Match her exact identity and illustration style: very large chibi head and compact body, thick long pale mint wavy hair with pointed curls, heavy asymmetric fringe hiding viewer-left eye, single visible pink/magenta eye with heavy black lashes on viewer-right, white frilled maid headband, black/pink hair bow and white flower, black-white maid dress with white apron/waist bow, pink neck bow, white buttoned cuffs, white stockings with black/pink bows, chunky black buckle shoes. Same fully clothed outfit and coverage. Bold black contours, big clean shapes and crisp grey-violet cel shadows, same mint/black/white/pink palette.
Priority: clearly expressive eyebrows/visible eye/mouth/cheeks and natural body language appropriate to ONE emotion. Relaxed, grounded everyday posture with gentle hand motions. No jump, sprint, power stance, exaggerated distortion or flying hair. Hair hangs under gravity.
Composition: ONE isolated full-body character on genuine transparent alpha, portrait canvas with clear space around ALL hair/headband/hands/shoes. No scenery, floor shadow, glow halo, tray, props, particles, emotional symbols, floating hearts, printed text, watermark or pose sheet. Two arms/two legs, anatomically coherent natural hands. The character interior is opaque and outside silhouette transparent.
EMOTION: unmistakable bright delight, delighted joyful laugh. Visible eye happily narrowed with upward-curving lower lid, still a little pink iris visible; lifted soft eyebrow, wide cheerful open smile with tongue and a small hint of upper teeth, warm slight cheek blush. Torso tilts very slightly forward in excitement. Both hands gently curled into small celebration fists near the upper chest, elbows low and close, shoulders relaxed, NOT hands covering face and NOT overhead arms. Weight comfortably on one grounded foot, other foot a little forward with heel nearly down; no jump. A happy everyday reaction with face readable at first glance.
